fact: A Ministry of Finance principal economist says the Malawi Social Registry is a vital tool for delivering social programmes, and a workshop moves it from a static to a dynamic database.
The World Bank mission says the Unified Beneficiary Registry (Malawi Social Registry) held 4.2 million households (17 million people) across 27 of 28 rural districts as of March 2025.
